description: Wire contracts, signed document schemas, scope vocabulary and the platform table shared by the Depot server, SDK and agents.
Offline verification of Depot licence documents for products to embed: chain, EKU, issuer pin, grace and online refresh.
The one signer and verifier for Depot release lines, manifests, promotions and operator approvals. BCL only, so every client, agent and the server run the same code.
Client SDK for Depot: publishing, resolving and downloading releases, the store, and licensing.
The Depot builder and signer agent loops as a library: a host supplies options, logging and key material and gets the same loop the depot console runs. No console, no flag names.
Optional C# code fixes for explicit Zendiator handler registrations.
JSON Schema generation for VYaml [YamlObject] types
